title: Canonical recursively generated tensor pairing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $F,G$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and $T,\eta,u_{n,i}$ the explicit Godement construction, unit and insertion maps [def-sc-module-cup-godement-model], with multiplication $\mu$ [def-sc-module-cup-godement-codegeneracies]. There exist morphisms $\beta_{H,K}:TH\otimes TK\to T(H\otimes K)$ for all module sheaves $H,K$, natural in both variables, satisfying $(\eta_H\otimes\eta_K)\beta_{H,K}=\eta_{H\otimes K}$ and $(\mu_H\otimes\mu_K)\beta_{H,K}=\beta_{TH,TK}T(\beta_{H,K})\mu_{H\otimes K}$. There also exist $p_n:T^nF\otimes T^nG\to T^n(F\otimes G)$ with $p_0=\mathrm{id}$, $p_{n+1}=\beta_{T^nF,T^nG}T(p_n)$ and $(u_{n,i}^F\otimes u_{n,i}^G)p_{n+1}=p_nu_{n,i}^{F\otimes G}$ for every $n\geq0$ and $0\leq i\leq n$. Composition is written from left to right.

proof.text: Obtain the one-step pairing maps and their three laws from beta_maps_exists, package them as ModuleCupGodementBeta, then obtain the recursively constructed pairings and insertion identities from iterate_pairings_from_beta. Return both witnesses and all identities.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_iterate_pairings_canonical_exists (X : Scheme.{u})
    (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (β : ModuleCupGodementBeta X)
      (p : ∀ n : ℕ, moduleCup_godementIterate X F n ⊗
        moduleCup_godementIterate X G n ⟶ moduleCup_godementIterate X (F ⊗ G) n),
      p 0 = 𝟙 (F ⊗ G) ∧
      (∀ n, p (n + 1) = β.map (moduleCup_godementIterate X F n)
        (moduleCup_godementIterate X G n) ≫ moduleCup_godementMap X (p n)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
        (moduleCup_godementInsert X F n i ⊗ₘ moduleCup_godementInsert X G n i) ≫
          p (n + 1) = p n ≫ moduleCup_godementInsert X (F ⊗ G) n i)
